name: neorest-monorepo
description: REST APIs with WebSockets. Do regular REST operations (GET, POST, DELETE) on routes, and subscribe to them.
author: Dmitry Kury (https://dkury.com)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @neorest/core && npm run build --workspace @neorest/router-core && npm run build --workspace @neorest/router-node && npm run build --workspace neorest
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace @neorest/tests
